description:
About our brand and products:

ELITE HYDRATION FOR SOFTBALL ATHLETES

She is 11 years old. She pitches. She plays shortstop. And she asks for Fastpitch Fuel before every single practice without being told to. Because she feels the difference. 



Her dad is a certified softball pitching coach through PaulyGirl FastPitch, who spent years behind the scenes developing nutrition formulas for major brands. He had access to elite manufacturers, chemists, and sports doctors that most founders never meet. 



He used all of it to build the one thing that did not exist: hydration made specifically for youth softball athletes. Not adapted from an adult formula. 

Not loaded with sugar. Built from scratch for the sport she loves. Zero sugar. NSF Certified. GMP Certified. Made in USA. Real fruit powder. 40 servings per tub.

Two flavors: Electric Lemon-Limeade and Sour Strawberry.

What makes us different:

We are not a generic supplement adapted from an adult formula. Fastpitch Fuel was built from scratch because nothing on the market was formulated for what youth softball athletes actually need. 

500mg Sodium (from Pink Himalayan Salt) replaces the number one electrolyte lost in sweat. 

340mg Potassium in the highly bioavailable citrate form prevents cramping and powers muscles through a full tournament day. 

60mg Magnesium tackles the exercise-induced cramping most sports drinks completely ignore. 

50mg Calcium Citrate supports bone density during the years it matters most for growing female athletes.

1000mg of real fruit powder per serving. Not citric acid. Not artificial flavor. Actual fruit. 

Sweetened with monk fruit and stevia. Zero sugar. Zero artificial anything. 

NSF Certified and GMP Certified. Made in the USA.

Every ingredient chosen by a sports nutrition professional for his own daughter. Kids ask for more. Parents trust every word on the label.

How affiliates can earn:

30% commission on every sale as a founding ambassador, permanently locked in for the first 20 approved applicants.

Monthly PayPal payouts with no minimums. 
Free product before your first post. Bonus payouts for top performers are paid manually each month.

How to promote us:

Share authentically with your softball community on TikTok and Instagram. Your unique link and discount code do the tracking automatically. No follower minimum. No posting requirements. 

Softball moms, coaches, fans, and players welcome.

Other information:

Launching May 2026. Customer sweepstakes running at launch, buyers earn entries for premium softball prizes, including Easton Ghost bats, based on the number of tubs they purchase. This gives your audience extra motivation to buy more, which means bigger commissions for you. Only 20 founding ambassador spots are available. Apply now.
